messages:
maria: FYI customer reported a 403 in the console after they renamed an IdP group yesterday. They can see org-level but when they click into project `proj-09a` they get `403 Permission denied`. They say this started right after a group rename in their IdP (Okta). Ticket #INC-8721 attached screenshots. customer pasted steps: 
1) Log into SSO (Okta)
2) Click Redwood Console -> Projects -> proj-09a -> 403
3) Admins still see the project. Non-admins in renamed group lost access.

alex: Thanks. Can you paste the exact SCIM/group mapping they use? Also any relevant `role` mapping in the org settings?

maria: Customer confirmed mapping: Okta group `engineering-backend` was renamed to `eng-be`. They use SCIM group sync for role assignment: SCIM group `engineering-backend` -> Redwood role `project-developer` on proj-09a. In org settings they have "map groups by external group name". They say group rename happened ~2026-07-21 03:12 UTC.

janet: Sounds like a group rename drift — SCIM usually preserves externalId but some Okta renames can change displayName only. Quick check: did SCIM externalId survive? If externalId changed, the mapping might have lost the link and left orphaned membership entries. Ask them to run a resync from their IdP or we can trigger a manual SCIM resync on our side.

maria: I asked for SCIM resync logs, they provided this excerpt:
```
2026-07-21T03:12:45Z SCIM PATCH /Groups/0a1b2c resp=200 updated displayName
2026-07-21T03:12:46Z webhook: group_rename event received
2026-07-21T03:12:48Z scim-sync: reconcile start for group 0a1b2c
2026-07-21T03:12:50Z scim-sync: members reconciled count=0 diff=+0
```
They said member list was unchanged.

alex: Hmm. If members didn't change but mapping did, it's likely our cached group->role pointer used the old displayName to match rules. Steps I want to try: 1) force SCIM full-sync on the org in our console, 2) if that doesn't fix, inspect `group_role_mappings` table for stale displayName entries and reconcile.

maria: Can you trigger the resync now? Customer is okay with us initiating.

janet: Triggered. I ran the admin API call to kick off full resync:
```
POST /orgs/0123/scim/sync
Authorization: Bearer <support-api-token>
{"type":"full"}
```
Response: `202 Accepted` — sync started. I'll follow logs.

support-bot: SCIM full sync job queued (job_id=job-99321) 

oncall-bot: Notifying oncall identity team.

janet: Log updates:
```
2026-07-21T03:18:12Z scim-sync job-99321: fetching remote groups
2026-07-21T03:18:14Z scim-sync: group 0a1b2c externalId=okta-grp-0a1b2c displayName=eng-be members=12
2026-07-21T03:18:15Z scim-sync: reconciled members=12, added=0 removed=0
2026-07-21T03:18:16Z scim-sync: updated local group record displayName from engineering-backend -> eng-be
2026-07-21T03:18:16Z scim-sync: updated mappings resolved for group 0a1b2c
```

alex: Any effect for the customer?

maria: They tried again — still 403. Screenshot shows `403: missing project role`. But interestingly, `project-developer` role appears in org UI mapping but clicking the role shows zero direct members (members are via groups).

ricardo: I pulled a quick query against `group_role_mappings`:
```
SELECT mapping_id, org_id, project_id, external_group_name, external_group_id, role
FROM group_role_mappings
WHERE org_id='0123' AND project_id='proj-09a' AND (external_group_name LIKE '%eng%');
```
Result: mapping exists but `external_group_id` is NULL for one mapping and `external_group_name` still references `engineering-backend` (old string). That explains why resync didn't remove it — there was a stale mapping row created before we had `external_group_id` persisted.

janet: That matches: older imports created a mapping by name only. Full resync updated group record but didn't retroactively fix that orphaned mapping row. Two options: 1) update `external_group_id` on mapping to match the group's externalId, 2) delete and recreate mapping. We should prefer a safe migration path.

alex: Is it safe to patch the DB row? If we set `external_group_id=okta-grp-0a1b2c` and update `external_group_name=eng-be` should members re-apply?

ricardo: Yes, but need a quick migration to ensure no race. I'll run the following in a transaction on read-replica promotion window:
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE group_role_mappings
SET external_group_id='okta-grp-0a1b2c', external_group_name='eng-be'
WHERE mapping_id='map-88877' AND org_id='0123';
COMMIT;
```
After that we trigger a mapping reconciliation job: `POST /internal/mappings/reconcile?org=0123` (internal endpoint).

maria: Customer is fine with the change but asked for rollback plan.

ricardo: Rollback is to restore the previous mapping row from DB backup (we'll snapshot the row) and mark a ticket for manual revert. I'll take a snapshot before applying and record migration id.

alex: Please proceed during low traffic window. Also add a note: if they later rename again, new mappings should be created with `external_group_id` key so this doesn't recur. We should add a prevent/guard in the sync to auto-fill null external_group_id on matching by name. Can we create a follow-up engineering ticket?

ricardo: Patch applied at 2026-07-21T03:34:01Z. Snapshot taken (snap-20260721-033401). Reconciliation job queued.

support-bot: Internal mapping reconcile job queued (job=rec-4582).

janet: Reconcile logs:
```
2026-07-21T03:34:10Z reconcile rec-4582: mapping map-88877 matched group okta-grp-0a1b2c, applied role to 12 members
2026-07-21T03:34:11Z reconcile: updated project membership cache for proj-09a
```

maria: Customer retried at 03:35 UTC and confirmed access restored. They reported no more 403s. They asked what caused it and how to prevent. I explained: the root cause was an old mapping row created by name-only mapping; when the group's displayName changed the mapping didn't auto-link because external_group_id was null. We fixed by linking mapping to the group's externalId and ran reconciliation.

alex: Next steps: 1) create a follow-up ticket for engineering to auto-populate `external_group_id` for name-only mappings during full sync and add a migration to backfill historical rows, 2) add a note in the SCIM docs about preferencing externalId over displayName, 3) consider a health check alert when group mapping references unknown displayNames.

maria: Customer satisfied, closing the incident. Thanks everyone :tada:

oncall-bot: Identity oncall acknowledged.

ricardo: Logged migration and snapshot in internal ops runbook. If anyone wants the exact SQL and migration id, ping me.
